declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtRight
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def leftModuleExtRight (M : A.LeftModule) (n : ℕ) : A.RightModule

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtRight_obj
declarations.full_header: @[simp] theorem leftModuleExtRight_obj (M : A.LeftModule) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) : (A.leftModuleExtRight M n).obj.obj (op ⟨i⟩) = ModuleCat.of k (Abelian.Ext.{v} M (A.leftRepresentable i) n)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtRightZeroIso

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtBoundaryRight

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtBoundaryRightEpi
declarations.full_header: noncomputable instance leftModuleExtBoundaryRightEpi {S : ShortComplex A.LeftModule} (hS : S.ShortExact) [Projective S.X₂] (n : ℕ) : Epi (A.leftModuleExtBoundaryRight hS n)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtDimensionShiftRightIso
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def leftModuleExtDimensionShiftRightIso {S : ShortComplex A.LeftModule} (hS : S.ShortExact) [Projective S.X₂] (n : ℕ) : A.leftModuleExtRight S.X₁ (n+1) ≅ A.leftModuleExtRight S.X₃ (n+2)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtDimensionShiftRightIso_hom
declarations.full_header: theorem leftModuleExtDimensionShiftRightIso_hom {S : ShortComplex A.LeftModule} (hS : S.ShortExact) [Projective S.X₂] (n : ℕ) : (A.leftModuleExtDimensionShiftRightIso hS n).hom = A.leftModuleExtBoundaryRight hS (n+1)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtPrecompRight
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def leftModuleExtPrecompRight {M N : A.LeftModule} (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ) : A.leftModuleExtRight N n ⟶ A.leftModuleExtRight M n

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtPrecompRight_boundary_zero
declarations.full_header: theorem leftModuleExtPrecompRight_boundary_zero {S : ShortComplex A.LeftModule} (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ) : A.leftModuleExtPrecompRight S.f n ≫ A.leftModuleExtBoundaryRight hS n = 0

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleADualMap_extRightZeroIso_inv
declarations.full_header: theorem leftModuleADualMap_extRightZeroIso_inv {M N : A.LeftModule} (f : M ⟶ N) : A.leftModuleADualMap f ≫ (A.leftModuleExtRightZeroIso M).inv = (A.leftModuleExtRightZeroIso N).inv ≫ A.leftModuleExtPrecompRight f 0

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftModuleExtBoundaryRight_exact
declarations.full_header: theorem leftModuleExtBoundaryRight_exact {S : ShortComplex A.LeftModule} (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ) : (ShortComplex.mk (A.leftModuleExtPrecompRight S.f n) (A.leftModuleExtBoundaryRight hS n) (A.leftModuleExtPrecompRight_boundary_zero hS n)).Exact
